_comment: High advisories in production dependencies that have no non-breaking fix yet, reviewed 2026-10-29. Remove an entry as soon as its fix ships. audit-gate.mjs fails again when a safe fix becomes available.

advisories.reason: SheetJS prototype pollution; the npm registry stops at 0.18.5, the fix (0.20.x) is only on cdn.sheetjs.com. Files are parsed in the user's own browser tab. Planned: move to the CDN tarball.
SheetJS ReDoS; same as above, fix only on cdn.sheetjs.com. Impact is a slow tab for the user's own file.

Memory exhaustion on oversized collections. Pulled in by @imgly/background-removal (zod ^3); the fix is zod 4.6.6, a major bump that package does not accept. zod only validates the app's own config there.
DoS in JXL/HEIF parsing. Used only by pptxgenjs in Node (its browser build maps image-size to false), so it is not in the web bundle. Fix needs image-size 2.x, a major bump pptxgenjs does not accept.
DoS in ICNS parsing. Same as above: Node-only path of pptxgenjs, not bundled for the browser.
libvips CVEs. sharp is a Node-only optional dependency of kokoro-js; the browser build never loads it. No fixed version that kokoro-js accepts.
libheif CVEs. Same as above: Node-only, not shipped to the browser.
librsvg CVE. Same as above: Node-only, not shipped to the browser.
